tei:div.tei:p: #!"#༄༅: mnga' dbang rin po che'i lo rgyus bzhugs so:

zangs mdzod/ yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi mchog: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i man ngag 'di: 'gro ba dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir: gnod sbyin nor gyi bang mdzod bca': bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs: rgyal po'i khyim du bcas pa yis: rgyal srid mnga' thang rgyas par 'gyur: rgyal khams bde zhing skyid par 'gyur: 'di nyams su len pa la gsum ste: dbang bskur te rgyal po bkra shis pa'i mnga' gsol ba dang: bang mdzod bcas te bsod nams kyi mtha' rgyas par bya ba dang: las sbyor brtsams te mnga' thang skyed pa'o: rgyal po la dbang bskur ba mnga' dbang rin po che zhes bya ba: dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo: padma 'byung gnas bdag gis kyang: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: skyes tshul sprul pa'i brda bstan tshe: yar ngo skar ma rgyal gyi nyin: gzhung la nyi ma shar ba'i tshe: mtsho gling padma'i dkyil du gyur: mtsho mtha' rdo rje'i brag ris gtams: bar khyams rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag mang po sprin ltar gtibs: kun kyang rin chen 'bar ba thogs: phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi rang gi mdun: srid gsum mnga' dbang srog gi bdag: zhi ma khro yi cha byad can: sku mdog 'byung ba lnga yi mdangs: phyag mtshan rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gter gyi bdag: srid gsum dbang gi ḍā ki ma: phyag na rin chen bum pa thogs: zhal nas srog gi yi ge lnga: 'jig rten phyogs bcu khyab par 'phro: srid gsum tshe srog dbang thang sdud: lha rnams mgrin gcig bsdus pa yi: dbang gi sgra yis rin po che: bdag gi gnas chen bco brgyad du: brda don rtags kyi dbang bskur byas: dam tshig gsum phog rgya gsum btab: lha rnams steng gi yum la thim: yum de bdag gi snying gar thim: phyi nang bde ba'i snang ba shar: phyag na rdo rje mkha' la byon: rin chen glegs bam mtho gang ba: bdag la gtad nas brda gsum gsungs: mkha' la sgra dang bcas te gshegs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ nor bu'i dbang chen thob pa dang: chos skyong rgyal po yab dang mjal: o rgyan rgyal por mnga' gsol lo: lo drug 'bangs kyi so tshis byas: de nas 'dzam gling khyab par btul: 'gro 'dul rgyal po padma ngas: khri srong lde'u btsan bsam pa bsgrubs: bod yul byang chub sems kyis btul: yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi mchog: snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag 'di: 'byung po 'dul byed rgyud nas btus: rgyud la le 'u lnga ru bstan: chos skyong rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i: mnga' dbang rin chen 'bar ba yod: tshe dang bsod nams mtha' rgyas phyir: gnod sbyin nor gyi bang mdzod yod: snang srid dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir: dbang byed rgyal po'i sgrub thabs yod: mtha' yi dgra bzhi 'dul ba'i phyir: dregs pa dbang sdud sgrub thabs yod: 'du 'dzi g.yeng bas long med na: bcas chog nor bu 'bar ba yod: lha dang bla ma man ngag la: yid ches mos gus med pa'i rigs: kha gsag stong zhus mkhas pa la: man ngag spel na rgyal khams phung: de phyir dam tshig bka' rgya yod: rgyud gcig man ngag drug bcas pa: rgyal srid rin chen bdun ldan 'dis: khri srong lde btsan bsam pa bsgrubs: ma dang bu yig gnyis su bkod: gcig ni rgyal po'i snying la chongs: rgyal po'i mnga' dar bod khams bde: rje 'bangs thams cad mtho ris bgrod: gcig ni rin chen gter du sbos: dus kyi snyigs ma shar ba'i tshe: rgyal khrims khre 'ur 'thor nas kyang: sde ba nang 'thab 'khrug pa 'ong: bsod nams nyams pa'i rtags bcu 'ong: rgyal po'i mnga' thang ma non pas: 'bangs kyis rje la rgol ba yong: 'dul khrims bstan pa nyams pa yis: btsun pas nyon mongs bab chol byed: gsang sngags dam nyams mang ba yis: dpon slob nang 'thab byed pa 'ong: chos la yang zor byed pa yong: bud med smad 'tshong byed pa yong: zas su sha khrag za ba 'ong: las su sdig la rngams pa 'ong: ngo tsha med cing sdig la rngams:

de ltar spyod ngan sna tshogs byas: yul phyogs grib kyi 'tshubs mas 'gribs: 'go ba'i lha lnga phyi la bros: gzhi bdag chos skyong bdud du babs: steng 'og lha srin thams cad 'khrugs: gnyan nad me ltar 'bar ba 'ong: rims nad char ltar sag pa 'ong: mtha' dmag chu ltar brdol ba 'ong: sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa 'ong: de dus bod khams snying rje'i phyir: o rgyan thugs kyi gter mdzod 'di: las can gcig dang 'phrad par 'gyur: las can gter dang 'phrad pa'i dus: brtson 'grus myur mgyogs byang sems skyed: bod kyi bde sdug mtshams su 'ong: mtha' yi dmag drug brdol du cha: bod la sdug res bab tu cha: mtshon cha char ltar 'bab tu cha: sgyogs dang me gtong yong du cha: bod kyi sems can zad du nye: de dus nga yi thugs rje las: bod la gces pa'i gter mdzod bzhi: mdzod bzhi'i snying khrag man ngag brgyad: sems bskyed bsam pa bzang po yis: nga yi bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa na: bod yul bde skyid ldan par 'gyur: nga yi sku yi gdul bya yis: bod du bde skyid 'byung 'dod na: gnas chen gangs ri bkra shis pa'i: rtse mo rtsa ba rked pa la: thugs kyi lha gsum rdzogs par bzhengs: rgyal po'i khab dang mi chen gnas: khrom chen 'du ba'i yul dbus su: sdug bsngal skyob byed lha bzhi bzhengs: dben gnas sgrub pa'i khang pa dang: dge 'dun 'du ba'i pho brang du: bkra shis dpal 'bar lha khang bzhengs: so so'i skye bo'i grong gseb dang: mtha' yul sdig spyod yul mtha' ru: snying rjes 'dren pa'i lha khang bzhengs: bod yul spyi dang sa phyogs su: gnod pa'i sa pra ngan pa dang: nad rims lhog brgal dar ba'i sa: g.yul bkye mi bsad 'khrugs pa'i sa: tshe thung nang 'khrugs dar ba'i sa: shi kha bye dang bkra mi shis: mi dge sdug bsngal thams cad kyi: sri mnan dpung gzhom phyir zlog pa'i: byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ nga yi gsung gi gdul bya yis: bod la bde skyid 'byung 'dod na: yar ngo'i tshes bcu nam shar tshe: o rgyan padma'i sprul pa 'byung: de dus nga la mos pa yis: rab kyis bskyed rdzogs gnas lugs ltos: phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub pa tshugs: sems bskyed bsam pa bzang po yis: 'gro drug thugs rjes 'dren pa yi: las dang smon lam rgya chen thobs: 'bring gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi: sgrib sbyong las la brtson par gyis: bka' yi gsung sgrogs mchod rten bzhengs: bsnyen par gnas dang sātstsha 'debs: srog bslu nye'u 'don bya ba dang: lam 'phrang zam pa gzug pa dang: dge 'dun mchod dang bskor ba bya: rang rang gang mos dge ba gyis: bdag la gus pas gsol ba thobs: tha ma tshes bcu nam shar tshe: srog gcod sdig pa'i las mi byed: rang gi sgo na 'khor ba yi: long sprang khyi dang dud 'gro la: ci 'byor sbyin pa snying brtses sbyin: mdor na yar gyi tshes bcu'i nyin: rab 'bring tha ma'i gang zag gis: sangs rgyas mchod dang sems can gso: yi ge 'bru gcig gus pas 'bri: snying rje'i sems kyis chu phor gang: sbyin pa gtong ba thams cad kun: padma 'byung gnas dus mchod yin: de dus nga yi smon lam gyis: dge ba ci 'grub 'bum 'gyur 'phel: nga yi thugs rjes rgyun du skyob: nga yi thugs kyi gdul bya yis: bod kyi bde skyid 'byung 'dod na: rgyal khrims chos khrims bzang po tshugs: rnam thar dpe lugs bzang po skyongs: bka' dang rgyud lung man ngag gi: phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub pa rnams: rang rang gang mos dam chos rnams: chad lhag bcos bslad med par sgrubs: de ltar byas pas bod yul 'dir: bde skyid ldan par the tshom med: de dus las dang smon lam gyis: mnga' bdag btsan po'i gdung rgyud 'di: mang yul stod du gnas par 'gyur: chos khrims bstan pa'i sgron ma dang: mnga' bskyed nor bu'i bang mdzod 'di:

gzhan la ma spel ma nyams par: gung thang rgyal po'i thugs la stims: rgyal pos nga yi bka' bzhin sgrubs: bdag dang khri srong lde btsan gyi: sems bskyed smon lam 'phro mthud nas: bod kyi rje 'bangs bde skyid dar: de dus blon po nag po yis: sri langs snyan phra log pa'i tshig: bar chad byed pa mang 'byung gis: chos khrims tshugs pas skyid par 'gyur: mnga' thang mtha' nas rgyas par 'gyur: rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas pa yis: smon lam stobs kyis bod 'bangs skyid: rgyal khams bde zhing skyid par 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: mnga' dbang rin po che gter gyi bang mdzod kyi lo rgyus: zhal chems brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i rked: zangs mdzod dmar po'i nang du sbas so: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ gter ston rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis bton pa'o: shog ser bu dngos grub rgyal mtshan gyi dpe las bshus so: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000250༄༅: 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud bzhugs: 1$0000300 zangs mdzod/ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo: ri rgyal lhun po'i rtse mo ru: khams gsum skye 'gro 'byung ba yi: srog dang dwangs ma bcud 'dus pa: 'od lnga'i dbus na srog yig lnga: lag na rdo rjes bsdus te blangs: 'jig rten phyogs bcu thams cad du: bstan pa skyong bar nus pa yi: las can re la 'phangs pa yis: 'gro 'dul skyes bu re re 'byung: khyad par lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling: thub pa'i zhing khams gnas chen 'dir: lo re bzhin du gdul bya gzigs: las can 'dug na srog yig 'beb: de yang zla ba skar ma gnyis: rgyal la babs pa'i nam langs tshe: sgra dang 'od zer sna lnga'i mdangs: nam mkha'i mthongs nas chas te 'bab: de phyir dge ba'i 'dun pa can: rgyal gyi zla ba skar ma gnyis: 'dzom pa'i dus su gsol ba thobs: rang gi bsod nams stobs yod pa: lo re bzhin du sum 'gyur 'phel:

dam tshig dge ba ci nus spyod: las dang smon lam stobs bskyed nas: skye ba gsum gyis bar ma chad: chos skyob rgyal po'i lus re len: e ma 'di ni nor bu che: srog gi snying po bsdus pa 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud las: gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o: ྈྈྈྈྈ de nas lag na rdo rje yis: 'jig rten srog yig dwangs ma de: byang chub sems kyis 'phangs pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dar rgyas dang: sems can skye 'gro'i las dbang gis: dang po bskal pa thog ma la: 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po byung: bar gyi bskal pa cha snyoms dus: chos skyong rgyal po re re byung: lnga brgya tha ma shar ba'i dus: dge spyod skyes bu re re 'byung: de yang dus dang gza' skar rtsi: rgyal gyi zla ba zhes bya ba: pho zla stag ltar ngar che ba: tshes gcig gza' dar g.yang skar tshes: tshes brgyad gza' dar grub skar 'dus: bco lnga gza' dar g.yang skar gang: rgyal dang zla ba gang ba 'dzom: de phyir rgyal gyi zla ba yin: dus ni tshes gcig stag ltar dpa': tshes brgyad bya ltar byed pa grub: bco lnga 'brug ltar sgra chen sgrog: de ltar dus dang gnad rtsis la: thabs chen rten 'brel bzang po blang ngo: srog gi snying po bsdus pa 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud las: dus dang gza' skar brtsi ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o: rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes gcig gi: stag skya kha rlangs 'don pa'i tshe: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la: khrus byas gtsang ma'i stan la sdod: gtsang ma'i gzhi la rin chen lngas: rang phyogs bskor la srog yig bri: ma yengs 'phro 'du ting 'dzin sgoms: bris nas tshon lnga'i gos kyis dgab: ratna'i khri la bzhugs su gsol: dang po stong pa'i ngang nyid las: bdag nyid hūm̐ las stobs chen lha: phyag na rdo rje gsal bar sgoms: de yi sku gsung thugs kyi 'od: lcags kyu lta bus 'jig rten gang: srid pa'i rtse mo man chad kyi:

lha klu mi dang sde brgyad srog: tshe bkrag bsod nams dbang thang dang: ratna nor bu mnga' thang gi: snying po dwangs ma 'od lngar bsdus: yi ge nyid la bstim par bya: srog gi snying po bsdus pa 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud las:
